capabilities: Rename the active file to the current text selection
Sanitize the selection into a valid filename
Bind a hotkey to the rename command
extras: Installation is manual (downloading main.js and manifest.json) or via the BRAT beta plugin installer; the README is minimal with no screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to rename a file from a text selection, so users must manually copy the selection and use the rename dialog.

relations.evidence: Use the Commander community plugin to add a command button near your file title
sanitize-filename-ts - to sanitize selection for filenames

summary: Single-command utility that renames the active note using the currently selected text, sanitized for valid filenames.
